questions.question: Which features must never be lost or broken?
questions.question_ar: ما الوظائف التي لا يجوز أن تضيع أو تنكسر؟
questions.default_reason: the features EAOS found on a critical path (auth, payments, data writes)

questions.question: How many users do you expect at the same time?
questions.question_ar: كم مستخدمًا تتوقع في الوقت نفسه؟
questions.default_reason: a small production application; the load scenario is sized to it until the owner says otherwise

questions.question: Does the system store personal data (names, emails, phone numbers, national ids)?
questions.question_ar: هل يخزّن النظام بيانات شخصية (أسماء، بريد، هواتف، أرقام هوية)؟
questions.default: derived from the tables and models in the code
questions.default_reason: a table or model with an email, phone or CPF field, or a name field on a person

questions.question: Does the system take payments?
questions.default_reason: no payment flow is assumed unless the owner declares one

questions.question: Where does the system run, and where should it run?
questions.question_ar: أين يعمل النظام، وأين يجب أن يعمل؟
questions.default: as it is: read from the repository

questions.question: How many people will work on it?
questions.default_reason: a vibe-coded project usually has one maintainer

questions.question: What availability must it keep, in percent?
questions.default_reason: a common target for a small production service (about 3.6 hours down a month)

questions.question: Which problems do you already know about?
questions.default_reason: none declared; the audit finds what it can
